resolved.title: 循环语法

content.text:
**循环**重复地执行一组语句，直到某个特定条件得到满足。

在C++中**while**循环: 只要满足条件为真，while循环会重复执行一组语句，直到满足某种特定的条件为止。

**语法：**
content.text_html:
A **loop **repeatedly executes a set of statements until a particular condition is satisfied.

A **while **loop statement repeatedly executes a target statement as long as a given condition remains true. Syntax:

一个循环重复地执行一组语句，直到某个特定条件得到满足。

一个**while 循环语句重复执行一个目标语句，只要一个给定的条件保持真。 语法：

content.text: 在条件为**真**时，循环会继续执行。
content.text_html:
The loop iterates while the condition is true.

在条件为**真时，循环迭代。

content.text: 当条件不成立(假)时，while里面的语句则不执行。
content.text_html:
At the point when the condition becomes false, program control is shifted to the line that immediately follows the loop.

在条件变成**假的时候，程序控制就会被转移到紧接着循环的那一行。

The example above declares a variable equal to 1 (int num = 1). The **while **loop checks the condition (num < 6), and executes the statements in its body, which increment the value of **num **by one each time the loop runs.

content.text: 在第5次迭代后，**num**变成了6，条件评估为**false**(假)，并且循环停止运行。
content.text_html:
After the 5th iteration, **num **becomes 6, and the condition is evaluated to false, and the loop stops running.

在第5次迭代后，num 变成了6，条件被评估为false，并且循环停止运行。

resolved.title: while 循环

content.text:
注意，条件表达式中变量值是可以改变的。
如果改变，循环运行的次数也会改变。
content.text_html:
The increment value can be changed. If changed, the number of times the loop is run will change, as well.

增量值是可以改变的。如果改变，循环运行的次数也会改变。

content.text: 如果循环条件一直为**真**时，循环将无限期地继续下去。
content.text_html:
Without a statement that eventually evaluates the loop condition to false, the loop will continue indefinitely.

如果没有一个最终将循环条件评估为**假的语句，循环将无限期地继续下去。

resolved.title: 3的倍数
resolved.problem_statement_md:
给定的程序，输出0到20的所有数字。

请修改代码，使其只输出为3倍数的数字。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]while loop[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are given a program that outputs all the numbers from 0 to 20.
Change the code to make it output only numbers that are [b]multiples of 3[/b].

[note]Be attentive and don't output 0.[/note]
